viewing_check: Photograph the typed label, check the colours (bright clean red points to 20th century rather than 19th), whether the dyes look natural or synthetic, fading, holes, repairs and how the panel is mounted. Ask whether it is a cut section of a larger pua kumbu (a cut piece is worth far less).
